pages.text:
A compact ring built round a vertical axis, major radius R from 3 to 7 blocks. Distances are measured from the axis column; heights from the midplane. Its plasma half-height h is (R - 1) / 2, rounded down.
# From the axis out
- Central Solenoid: the axis column, between the coil layers.
- First Wall: the inner wall 1 out, and the roof. The floor is Divertor Cassettes.
- The plasma chamber: air, 2 to R - 1 out, h above and below the midplane.
- Breeding Blanket: the outer wall R out (its face armoured, as real blanket modules are), and a layer over and under.
- Toroidal Field Coils: the top and bottom layers, with the Poloidal Field Coils set into them as rings 1 out and R out.

- The cryostat: a round wall of Cryostat Casing R + 1 out, the full height. The coils' outer legs run up inside it.
So a reactor is 2R + 3 blocks across: 9 at R 3, 17 at R 7, and 9 to 13 blocks tall.
# The wall
The controller goes in the cryostat's wall at the midplane, straight out from the axis (the middle of a side), facing out. Vessel Ports (for modules and arms) and Reactor Glass (viewports: the plasma glows through them) may stand anywhere in the wall. Any wall block can be a port.

# Sizes
At R 3 (9×9×9): 44 First Wall, 20 Divertor, 152 Blanket, 26 Toroidal Field Coil, 48 Poloidal Field Coil, 7 Central Solenoid and 288 Cryostat Casing, 592 in all. R 5 (13×13×11) is about twice that, R 7 (17×17×13) about three and a half times.
# Ports
- Input: Water or Helium (wall cooling), Lead-Lithium, Liquid Helium and Liquid Nitrogen.
- Output: Hot Coolant from the wall, or Hot Helium on the helium loop. Hot Leg: Hot Lead-Lithium from the blanket.
- Energy: FE for the magnets and the Central Solenoid. The modules take their own.
